Elite Collection Egg Knob with Ketme Roses

text.description_html:
Fusion 02-A5, Elite Collection Egg Knob with Ketme Rose

Fusion Hardware knows what lovers of traditional home decor want. They want classic shapes, quality, and an elegance that exudes the richness of the history behind the styles. The Egg Knob with Ketme Rose has all that. Its beauty comes from the old world feel. Although it seems like every vendor offers an egg-shaped knob, very few are actually used in decorating; and for us, a traditional shape that can still hold a little bit of the unexpected is something really grand. The Fusion 02-A5 Elite Collection Egg Knob with Ketme Rose features concealed screws for a beautiful look once installed. It is available in an array of finishes. This solid brass knobset will fit 1-3/8 inch to 2 inch thick doors and has an adjustable backset for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches.

Features of the Fusion 02 A5 Egg-Shaped Knobset with Ketme Rose:

  • Solid Brass/Bronze Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • Exclusive Fusion knob spring assembly for lifetime performance.
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish.
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts.
  • Concealed screw rose cover.

Specifications for the Traditional Egg Door Knob:

  • Knob Length: 2-3/8"
  • Knob Width: 1-3/8"
  • Knob Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Rose Projection: 3/8"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" to 2-3/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass and Bronze
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates.
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: Non-functional pull to match trim on one side of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Dummy Set: Non-functional pull to match trim on both sides of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
